_why: The sha256 of each launchd template's NORMAL FORM (see cbrain/plist_normalise.py), and the migration decision taken when that form last changed. Changing a template semantically shuts the legacy adoption window for every machine that has not adopted yet: update the hash AND say here what happens to them. tests/launchd_template_migration.py goes red otherwise.

com.claudebrain.machiniste.plist.templat.migration_decision: none needed -- first baseline, 2026-08-20. No semantic change has been published since legacy adoption existed.

com.claudebrain.resume.plist.template.migration_decision: none needed -- first baseline, 2026-08-20. No semantic change has been published since legacy adoption existed.

com.claudebrain.etat.plist.template.migration_decision: none needed -- first baseline, 2026-09-25. The installer does not render this template (install.sh and adopt-launchd.sh handle resume and machiniste only); it is installed by hand, with the two sed substitutions its header gives.
